missing: A comparison of triple-screen extenders (Aura, FOPO, Stradale, INVZI and others) that explains the M3 limit and shows how each one gets around it. A base M3 MacBook Pro natively drives only one external display, so a shopper needs to know which units use DisplayLink/driver-based connections and work across all screens on M3. That should come with tested results, current prices and any working codes.
why: The only major reviewers are off-question: TechRadar covers desk monitors and Tom's Guide covers M6 accessories. Everything else is maker or retailer product pages with unverified claims like "works with macOS" or "M1–M3", plus a dead 404 page. No page compares extenders or deals with the M3 external-display limit, so a focused page that does would stand out.
